title: SDM-PEB: Spatial-Depthwise Mamba for Enhanced Post-Exposure Bake Simulation
problem: Post-exposure bake (PEB) simulation requires precise 3D modeling of photoacid diffusion and inhibitor reactions to ensure resist profile accuracy and circuit pattern fidelity in semiconductor lithography.
motivation: PEB is a critical step in lithography that directly impacts circuit patterning accuracy, and existing methods lack precision in capturing spatial and depthwise dependencies in 3D diffusion processes.
method: SDM-PEB uses a hierarchical feature extractor with overlapped patch merging and efficient self-attention, combined with a spatial-depthwise Mamba-based attention unit employing customized selective scan and structured state space models to capture both coarse and fine features at multiple scales and 3D dependencies.
key_novelty: Spatial-depthwise Mamba-based attention architecture using customized selective scan to efficiently model inter-layer diffusion and intra-layer spatial variations in PEB, rather than standard convolution or simple attention.
contributions: Hierarchical feature extractor with overlapped patch merging for multi-scale feature capture
Spatial-depthwise Mamba-based attention using customized selective scan and state space models
PEB focal loss and differential depth divergence regularization to address data imbalances in 3D simulation
Improved accuracy and efficiency over previous methods validated against commercial rigorous models

metrics.other: Outperforms previous methods in accuracy and efficiency (specific numbers not provided in abstract)

limitations: Abstract does not discuss computational complexity, inference time, area/memory requirements, or comparison with other state-of-the-art lithography simulators.
primary_theme: Mamba-based neural simulator for lithography PEB process
